Based on Example 2, define
$$Y_3(\omega):=\begin{cases}0& \omega \in [p,1]-\{\frac{1+p}{2}\}\\ 1& \omega \in [0,p) \cup \{\frac{1+p}{2}\}\end{cases}$$
Then the pushforward measure is unchanged:
$$P_{Y_3}(\{0\})=m\left([p,1]-\left\{\frac{1+p}{2}\right\}\right)=1-p,\qquad P_{Y_3}(\{1\})=m\left([0,p) \cup \left\{\frac{1+p}{2}\right\}\right)=p.$$

import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory

noncomputable def Y3 (p : ℝ) (ω : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if ω ∈ (Set.Icc p 1 \ ({((1 + p) / 2)} : Set ℝ)) then 0
  else if ω ∈ (Set.Ico 0 p ∪ ({((1 + p) / 2)} : Set ℝ)) then 1
  else 0
